tasks.test:browser: deno task build && deno test --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --allow-net --allow-run --allow-sys=homedir,osRelease tests/browser
tasks.test: deno task build && deno test --allow-read --allow-env tests/*_test.ts && deno test --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --allow-net --allow-run --allow-sys=homedir,osRelease tests/browser
tasks.check: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno check app.ts desktop.ts desktop.dev.ts server.ts scripts/*.ts tests/*_test.ts tests/browser/*.ts src/pages/api/editor/*.ts src/pages/api/releases/*.ts && astro check && deno task test
tasks.desktop: deno task build && deno desktop --no-check --icon=public/desktop-icon.png --allow-env=HOME,XDG_DATA_HOME,LOCALAPPDATA,APPDATA,PORT,DENO_SERVE_ADDRESS,DENO_DESKTOP,WRITASAURUS_DESKTOP --allow-net --allow-read --allow-write --allow-run=zenity,kdialog,which,osascript,powershell desktop.ts
